production: Choose and inspect one representative moving shot before full rendering.
Keep an immutable source model; save per-shot camera, lighting and render settings.
Render checkpointed image sequences, then assemble MP4. Resume only missing/invalid frames.
Do not substitute a slideshow or claim panorama turns are translational camera movement.
Use V-Ray source lighting/materials for fidelity when available; any Blender remapping requires side-by-side approval.
No invented full-flat interiors in this bedroom film.
Generative video is an optional separately reviewed interpretation; reject drifting products, geometry and finishes.
